candidates.title: 'Get ready to come home,' Wakeham says to former N.L. residents searching for Churchill Falls jobs
candidates.description: A rally-like celebration of the prospect of jobs tied to the Churchill Falls and Gull Island hydroelectric projects ended with a call from Newfoundland and Labrador Premier Tony Wakeham to trades workers who have previously left the province for work.

candidates.description: When Stan Dworkowski awoke from an eight-day coma with 24 broken ribs and a fractured skull, he could not recall his own age or the faces of his closest friends. He is now retracing his steps, hoping to piece together the hours before he was injured.

candidates.description: People in La Loche, Sask., and other communities in the northwest see a chance to build services and a quality of life that outlast the boom and bust cycles of a resource-based economy.

candidates.description: The growing world of "actual play" is taking tabletop role-playing games from living rooms and online streaming to sold-out theatres. candidates.title: Trump to Bombardier: You can't sell in U.S. unless you build in U.S.
